# Memmy v1.2.5

## Highlights

- Manage official plugins from the marketplace, with permission checks, installed and latest version labels, clearer installation status, and manual update progress.
- Use Literature Review workflows with clearer model requirements, recoverable private-instruction loading, bounded stalled calls, and checkpoint-based recovery for supported tasks.
- Keep legal guidance and interview materials in their conversation, with recording controls, saved transcripts, and diagnosis-upload checks.
- Create, edit, inspect, and render DOCX, PDF, PPTX, and XLSX with the Office plugin, including improved Chinese DOCX/PDF output and macOS/Windows renderer compatibility.

## Agent and Desktop improvements

- Keep recording duration and playback progress synchronized when media metadata is short or invalid. Seeking stays bounded, and playback completion reaches the end of the progress bar. (MEMMY-922)
- Fix recording-only chats remaining "Untitled task". Reuse saved transcript names and paths for attachments, and generate conversation titles from permitted transcript text. (MEMMY-929)
- Keep internal model preset identifiers out of slash-command suggestions. Use `/model` or `/model list`, and switch by preset or an unambiguous available model name.
- Prepare the TeX runtime in the background so ordinary review work can continue while operations that require TeX wait for readiness.
- Preview DOCX, PDF, PPTX, and XLSX in the workspace, keep completed files attached to the relevant reply, and preserve visible tool failures after partially successful deliveries.
- Improve interrupted-task recovery, keeping paused task plans and scheduled retries consistent.
- Improve Chinese plugin labels, slash-command caret visibility, the home composer layout, and the invite field in Knowledge sharing dialogs.
- Improve Memory responsiveness while processing large pending policy queues. Plugins can reuse the configured Memory embedding service for document and query embeddings.

## Upgrade notes

- Desktop and Agent: `1.2.5`. Bundled Memory: `2.1.7`. Office plugin: `0.2.6` (installed and updated separately).
- Install Office separately from the marketplace. Finish active Agent work before applying a manual plugin update, and check its installed version and progress.
- First use of Office or a TeX-dependent operation may wait for verified runtime downloads. Allow preparation to finish before retrying an export.
- Recordings must finish transcription before diagnosis upload. Existing recording transcripts can be attached to a conversation without uploading a duplicate copy.
